# 新增18个生活场景的生成提示词

2026-09-11，均使用内置 image_gen；原始PNG与每张完整元数据保存在 output/scene-expansion-20260911/originals。全部为原创环境，不使用现实地图或地标素材。

运行时保持1536×1024原尺寸，以无损WebP编码，完整RGBA经逐像素验证一致。相机与可摆家具的地面按既有场景设计。

## 温室花房 · sunroom-glass

商店价格：1500 金币。

```text
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: full-scene illustrated background for a cozy furniture-placement game.
Input image: the supplied room.png is ONLY an art-style, material-rendering, color-harmony and soft upper-left lighting reference. Create an entirely NEW architectural scene, not an edit of that room and not a weather variant of its architecture. Do not copy its shelving layout or furnishings.
Style/medium: polished original hand-painted picture-book illustration, opaque gouache, delicate natural pencil edges, soft visible paper grain. Honey wood, creamy walls and rich natural greens, matching the supplied reference's tactile brushwork, gentle atmosphere and believable materials.
Composition/framing: landscape full bleed 3:2, ideally 1536 by 1024 pixels, no frame. Slightly elevated three-quarter frontal view with clear floor perspective. The LOWER approximately 60 percent of the canvas must be a broad, level, continuous EMPTY usable floor surface. Keep principal architecture and decorative detail in the upper 40 percent and at the distant side edges. The floor-wall junction at the rear should sit around 40 percent of image height. Center and foreground are spacious, unobstructed, ready for separately placed game furniture. Do not draw decorative foreground framing objects.
Constraints: no people, animals, portable furniture, tables, chairs, beds, rugs, floor pots, crates, baskets, tools, UI, text, logos, watermarks, maps or borders. Fixed architecture and a few distant wall-mounted details only. No movable furniture is baked into this background. Completely opaque painted environment, no transparency.
Scene/backdrop: an airy greenhouse conservatory with thin cream-painted glass framing and an arched glazed roof. Dense leafy climbing vines grow only on the rear glazing and distant side edges, with restrained fixed greenhouse planting troughs set tightly against the far wall. Gentle sunlight from the upper left. Lower 60 percent: entirely clear pale honey-colored stone tile floor, soft shadows only. Palette: warm cream, pale honey stone, luxuriant green foliage.
```
